reports.title: MOBILITY GLOBAL REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: guidance
section: “Our first full quarter as a standalone public company was a solid one, with growth stepping up from the first
half across both segments," said Bill Eager, Chief Executive Officer of Mobility Global. “We are bringing our
CARFAX and B2B businesses together as One Mobility Global and applying AI to our proprietary data, trusted
brands and deeply embedded customer relationships to deliver more value to our customers and drive growth.
We believe our strong cash generation enables us to invest in these priorities while returning capital to
shareholders through our dividend and share repurchase program. We remain focused on disciplined execution,
